HTTP is Unidirectional And Stateless, half-duplex Protocol.
Most websites use this as it fulfills the need of most websites.
Polling - process of sending requests repeatedly in fixed time interval.
Short and Long Polling
Short Polling - Sends request in a short interval to the server. Brings empty data packets if the request is not fulfilled, so very resource wasteful.
Long Polling - Sends request in a longer interval to the server. Brings empty data packets if the request is not fulfilled, so very resource wasteful.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Server Sent Events are unidirectional, only server can communicate data, not the client.
Used in Broadcasting , LIVE Events, Notification sent to lot of users etc.
GPT uses these.
Websockets - Stateful, Persistent, Bidirectional, Full-Duplex connection.
First request is sent by client to server , of a http handshake request with upgrade header.
Websocket me first request from client to server is an http.

Handshake complete -> Websocket Established.

Used for fetching data in real-time, used in chatting apps, trading apps etc.

For using and exchanging data using websocket, start the server by navigating to the server directory in cmd, and start using node server.js

Server will start on 8080 port, and data can be received by hoppscotch, after putting url and connecting.

For Server we wrote code for server , for client we used Hoppscotch.

[https://hoppscotch.io/realtime/websocket](https://hoppscotch.io/realtime/websocket)
